description: Get Discord's computed permissions for a role together with @everyone in a server or channel, including the bitfield and known permission names. Channel calculations include overwrites for these roles.

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for human-readable or 'json' for structured data

implicit.description: Apply implicit permission masking for missing View Channel or Connect access. Discord defaults to true.

scope.description: Discord server or channel whose permissions to calculate

name: discord_get_role_permissions
title: Get Discord Role Permissions
